chapters: One beam, with a fixed end and a loaded end.
The wired end attaches to the housing. The other end carries the blue bracket.
Contact force travels through the cartridge and bracket.
The silver beam bends slightly; its strain gauges generate a small electrical signal.
Lift away and the beam returns.
An HX711 reader and calibration would turn the signal into a grams-force reading.
The machined beam is the spring and the sensor.
This is a proposed mounting arrangement; the blue bracket must be checked for off-axis loading.
